title: My profile
previewNote: This is what other members see. Photos being checked only show up for them once approved.
noPhotos: Add photos so others can discover you.

tips.add_photo: Add a photo where your face is clearly visible
tips.add_alt_text: Describe your photos for screen readers

fields.birthDateLocked: Your date of birth can't be changed. If it's wrong, write to us from the help page.

errors.firstName: Only letters, spaces, hyphens or apostrophes.

anthem.title: My current song
anthem.search: Search a song or an artist
anthem.unavailable: Music search isn't answering. Try again later.
anthem.saved: Your current song is on your profile.

share.title: Your holographic card
share.lead: An image to share wherever you like. You choose what it shows; it isn't stored anywhere online.
share.name: My first name

verification.entryHelp: A selfie with a gesture, compared with your photos by the moderation team.
verification.title: Prove it's really you
verification.lead: A selfie reproducing a random gesture. A member of the moderation team compares it with your photos, then deletes it. No automatic face recognition.

privacy.title: What happens to your selfie
items: It is never shown on your profile.
Only the moderation team sees it, for the time of the check.
It is deleted as soon as a decision is made.

gestures.peace: Make a V with two fingers
gestures.hand_on_head: Put your hand on top of your head
gestures.open_palm: Show your open palm to the camera
gestures.hand_on_chin: Rest your hand under your chin

verification.deadline: Take it before {time}, with your face clearly visible.

camera.denied: The camera is not available. Allow it in your browser, or use the camera app.
camera.fallback: Take the photo with the camera app

processing.title: Sent
processing.body: We are preparing your selfie for the moderation team.

pending.title: Sent
pending.body: A member of the moderation team checks it, usually within 24 hours. You will get an email.

approved.title: Verified photo
approved.body: The badge shows on your profile. Your selfie has been deleted.

rejected.title: Not approved this time
rejected.body: {reason}. Your selfie has been deleted: try again with a new gesture.

failed.title: Unreadable photo
failed.body: We could not read your photo. Draw a new gesture and try again.

reasons.gesture_mismatch: The gesture did not match the one requested
reasons.face_mismatch: We could not confirm that your photos show you
reasons.unclear: The selfie was too blurry or too dark, or your face was hidden
reasons.not_live: The photo did not seem to be taken on the spot

blockers.no_photo: First add at least one photo of yourself: your selfie will be compared with it.
blockers.quota: Three attempts per day at most. Come back tomorrow.

verification.expired: Time is up: draw a new gesture.
verification.error: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
